mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in the last 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE decreases > 0.5% in 3 months does not lead to positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% in the last 2 months signals increased economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases > 5% in 2 months does not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in the last 2 months signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO decreases > 1% in 2 months does not lead to negative 5-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over 3 consecutive months signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases over 3 consecutive months do not lead to positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is below 2% YoY, it signals a restrictive monetary policy in a low-growth environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: restrictive monetary policy in low-growth environment
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 2% and GDPC1 YoY < 2% do not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3% in the last month, it signals a strong labor market, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200,000 and UNRATE decreases > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases > 200,000 and UNRATE decreases > 0.3% in 1 month do not lead to positive 5-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% in the last 2 months, coupled with a decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% in the last month, signals a significant contraction in demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST decreases > 10% in 2 months and RSAFS decreases > 1% in 1 month
failure_condition: If HOUST decreases > 10% in 2 months and RSAFS decreases > 1% in 1 month do not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.
